note: Curated team metadata layered on top of WHRG 2026 results in data.js. If a team is absent here, team.html builds a generic profile from the event results.

teams.name: SPQR · Sapienza University of Rome
teams.summary: Italian RoboCup team from Sapienza University of Rome. At WHRG 2026 it reached the final of the 5v5 Large Division and won silver, losing 10–1 to Tsinghua Hephaestus.

whrg2026.note: Maker Faire Rome described SPQR as the only non-Chinese team to reach the semifinals of this bracket.

robots.whrgCountNote: The event was 5×5. SPQR publicly said it was using new Booster T2 robots in Beijing, but the exact number of T2 units in the delegation was not stated in the sources used here.
otherPlatforms: NAO v6 — SPQR's Standard Platform League setup is described as a team of 7 NAO v6 robots.
Booster T1 — the March 2026 RoboCup team description stated that SPQR owned one competition-ready T1 before the later T2 deployment.

robotSpecs.scopeNote: Manufacturer-level T2 specifications; the exact SPQR edition/configuration used at WHRG 2026 is not independently confirmed.
robotSpecs.vision: Binocular head camera + binocular abdominal camera
robotSpecs.compute: Education: 375 TOPS; Pro: Jetson Thor T5000, 2,070 TFLOPS (manufacturer specification)

teams.name: Tsinghua Hephaestus
teams.summary: Tsinghua University humanoid football team and WHRG 2026 champion of the 5v5 Large Division.

robots.whrgCountNote: The sources used for this project confirm the team and result, but not a precise WHRG 2026 hardware configuration. Tsinghua Hephaestus used Booster T1 at RoboCup 2026.

teams.name: GMO Robots
teams.organization: GMO Internet Group / GMO AI & Robotics
teams.summary: Japanese humanoid robotics program. In the published WHRG 2026 1500 m protocol, GMO Robots placed 7th in 7:43.89.

robots.whrgCountNote: GMO operates several humanoid platforms, but the exact model used for this WHRG 1500 m result is not confirmed in the sources currently attached to the project.
